environment.description: Same Quarkus function deployed in namespace 'reporting-prod'. Namespace has a Cilium L3/L4 CiliumNetworkPolicy (not standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy) with spec.egress containing a single toCIDR rule allowing 10.0.0.0/8 and a toCIDRSet with cidrGroupRef 'internal-services' that resolves to the cluster service CIDR. The policy uses spec.egressDeny with toCIDR 169.254.169.254/32 as an explicit deny-list entry. Additionally, the GKE Workload Identity federation is configured with an IAM binding that maps the KSA 'report-generator' to a GCP SA with only roles/storage.objectViewer on a single bucket. The node pool has metadata concealment enabled (legacy endpoint disabled, --workload-metadata-from-node=GKE_METADATA) which returns 403 for any metadata server token request from pods using Workload Identity. Pod spec includes a securityContext with allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and readOnlyRootFilesystem: true.
